description: The agent must: (1) Locate and read /workspace/skills/near-content-creator/SKILL.md to discover the implementation entrypoint (dist/index.js) and the exact command names (near_content_thread, near_content_news, near_content_tutorial). (2) Invoke `node /workspace/skills/near-content-creator/dist/index.js near_content_thread validators` and save the JSON output as validator_thread.json — critically, the output must be a JSON array of exactly 8 strings each starting with the stable '1/8', '2/8', ... '8/8' prefix (the key proprietary constraint from SKILL.md; agents relying on generic knowledge will produce 'Tweet 1:' or '1/n' formats). (3) Invoke the near_content_news command and save the structured JSON list (with url fields and ranking) as ecosystem_news.json. (4) Invoke `near_content_tutorial staking` and save the markdown output as staking_tutorial.md — the tutorial must be practically structured with executable NEAR CLI commands in code blocks, not generic prose. The agent must navigate distractor files (outdated configs, old drafts in wrong formats, a stub dist/index.js in the wrong directory) and must use the exact proprietary command names from SKILL.md rather than guessing common synonyms.
